description.value: Kutlet is a Korean restaurant in Tsawwassen's Canoe Pass Way development, specialising in Korean-style cutlets. It offers dine-in with reservations as well as pickup and third-party delivery through DoorDash and Uber Eats. The restaurant also produces and sells house-made kimchi jars as a retail item.

address.value: 2208-4949 Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen, BC V4M 0B2

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 91m; rack (10 spaces) at 96m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the OSM address (2208-4949 Canoe Pass Way, Tsawwassen/Delta BC) and shows active ordering infrastructure: pickup, DoorDash, Uber Eats, and a reservation system, supporting takeout as confirmed. The front-page text soliciting sign-ups for a 'grand opening invitation' raises a flag about whether the restaurant is currently trading, but looks_closed=false, hours are published on the cart subpage, and the ordering system appears live. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Website front page solicits sign-ups for a 'grand opening invitation', suggesting the restaurant may be newly opened or still pre-opening — operators should verify it is actively trading before the listing goes live.

OSM lists city as 'Delta'; website footer lists 'Tsawwassen, BC' — Tsawwassen is within Delta municipality so this is not a true contradiction, but the postal address has been updated to match the website.
Phone number from OSM (+1-604-244-4578) is not displayed on the website, so phone confirmation is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible Korean restaurant with an active website, ordering system, and published hours; looks_closed=false. Suitable for inclusion as a food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website email (hello@kutlet.ca) not present in OSM record — may be worth adding.

wow_evidence: Korean restaurant in Tsawwassen's Canoe Pass Way development
